title: Candidate MassLedger Observer Architecture
qualification_detail: candidate observer architecture derived from PREP06 conservation identities and ARCH01/ARCH02 ownership and transaction semantics; exact conserved-quantity, control-volume, observer-field, identity and 53-family state-projection registries are structurally consistent; canonical MASS admission and behavioural closure remain blocked
architecture_decisions: MassLedger is an observer of canonical owner state and typed transfer events and never owns physical mass
beginning and end storage are generated from the same state-to-ledger projection registry
every ARCH01 state/non-state family has an explicit storage projection or explicit exclusion
one immutable typed event journal supports multiple control-volume views
internal versus external classification is derived from event endpoint membership in the selected control volume
physical event amounts are non-negative and direction carries sign semantics
conserved quantity remains distinct from source and sink species or carrier identity
reaction partitions expose bundle-level nonclosure independently of profile closure
numerical constraints expose diagnostic nonclosure and do not become balancing physical fluxes without separate qualification
initialization projection has its own nonclosure channel and is not hidden in the first runtime step
reporting accumulators and detailed transfer reports are observers only and cannot participate in physical closure
soil-only and soil-plus-crop ledgers are views of the same events rather than separate process bookkeeping
matrix-plus-macropore OM N and P views remain conditional feature-blocked designs
organic matter mass crop dry matter and elemental gas carbon remain separate quantity contracts
ARCH03 defines semantic zero residual but no numerical tolerance policy
remaining_blockers: MIGRATION_DAG still requires qualified migration baseline QM before canonical STATE admission and TIME before MASS
PREP02 historical or independently trusted reference environment remains unresolved
controlled immutable B0 retention remains a separate governance gate
ARCH01 is not yet admitted as canonical state ownership
generic TIME acceptance retry and transaction policy is not yet canonically qualified
no production typed-event journal producer exists
no numerical closure tolerance policy is admitted
no frozen-reference behavioural closure suite has been executed for the candidate ledger
GHG whole-system elemental-C and N theory-to-ledger reconciliation remains incomplete
supplied testbank has no active macropore case and TCD-025 remains feature-blocking
TCD-029 multi-site fast-sorption management semantics remain unresolved

parallel_now: define an explicit feature activation and state-allocation matrix for surface reservoir crop GHG macropore and variable P site counts without implementing production state
define a candidate typed-event journal producer/lifecycle contract that remains subordinate to future canonical TIME semantics
prepare future MassLedger behavioural qualification cases for water N P OM crop and feature-conditional views without calling them historical reference evidence
continue PREP02 reference recovery and controlled B0 retention independently
serial_after_qm: qualify or revise ARCH01 as canonical STATE
qualify generic TIME and transaction semantics
then implement and behaviourally qualify MassLedger against admitted state and event producers
